notes.title: 3D PrintMaster Simulator: Launching December 5, 2023!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44112941/75a2b6a253efe1807b09fa10ba6a3673e81670b1.png[/img]

"We're excited to announce that '3D PrintMaster Simulator,' the ultimate 3D printing simulation game, is set to launch on December 5, 2023! This engaging and detailed simulator allows players to step into the world of 3D printing technology, where they can build, customize, and manage their very own 3D printing workshop.

Players will start with assembling their first printer from various parts, progressing to upgrade their equipment and take on more complex printing orders. The game offers a realistic assembly experience, where using tools like wrenches, hexagons, and screws is part of the gameplay.

In '3D PrintMaster Simulator,' you will not only create and print 3D objects but also manage the business aspect of your workshop. Navigate a dynamic in-game economy, sell and trade printer parts, and grow your business to become the ultimate 3D PrintMaster.

Get ready to immerse yourself in the exciting world of 3D printing technology. Mark your calendars for December 5, 2023, and prepare to embark on a unique simulation journey!"
